environment: Room Sync local interactive PoC – checks run in isolated in-memory state

results.title: Equal expense split
results.setup: Zero balances. Syed pays $60.00, split equally among all three members.

results.title: Remainder cents
results.setup: Zero balances. Syed pays $10.00, split equally. Remainder follows Syed → Abin → Debbie.

results.title: Custom split
results.setup: Zero balances. Debbie pays $49.00. Shares: Syed $20.00, Abin $14.50, Debbie $14.50.

results.title: External settle-up
results.setup: Start from Scenario A. Abin records paying Syed $20.00 outside the app.

results.title: Invalid custom split is blocked
results.setup: A $30.00 expense with custom shares totalling $29.99 ($10.00 + $10.00 + $9.99).
expected: New expenses / activity / balance changes: none
actual: Feedback: $0.01 still to allocate. Shares must add up to $30.00.
New expenses / activity / balance changes: none

results.title: Weekly chore rotation
results.setup: A weekly chore starts with Syed in week 1. It is completed, then the demo week advances three times.

results.title: Local persistence across reload
results.setup: Clean scenario in an isolated in-memory store: add an expense, complete a chore, switch to French, save, then reload from storage.
expected: Balances after reload: Syed −$15.00, Abin +$30.00, Debbie −$15.00 (total $0.00)
Malformed saved data: detected, demo restored
actual: Balances after reload: Syed −$15.00, Abin +$30.00, Debbie −$15.00 (total $0.00)
Malformed saved data: detected, demo restored

results.title: Switching active roommate preserves totals
results.setup: Populated demo. Switch the active roommate Syed → Abin → Debbie and compare derived balances.
expected: Household balances unchanged: Syed +$61.19, Abin −$8.49, Debbie −$52.70
actual: Household balances unchanged: Syed +$61.19, Abin −$8.49, Debbie −$52.70

results.title: Switching language preserves data
results.setup: Populated demo. Switch EN → FR → EN; compare records and integer-cent balances.
actual: Syed: $40.00 (EN) / 40,00 $ (FR) from the same 4000 cents; current balance +61,19 $

results.title: Expense input validation
results.setup: Submit drafts with an empty description, invalid, zero, negative and over-precise amounts, a negative share and over-allocated shares.
expected: empty description: blocked with specific error
empty amount: blocked with specific error
negative custom share: blocked with specific error
shares exceed total: blocked with specific error

results.title: Repeated save creates one record
results.setup: Dispatch the same add-expense action (same draft id) three times, as a rapid double/triple click would.

results.title: Zero-sum invariant under 500 random records
results.setup: Seed 20261109: 400 random equal/custom expenses and up to 100 valid settle-ups, checking the invariant after every step.
expected: Suggested transfers clear all balances: yes
actual: Suggested transfers clear all balances: yes (2 transfers)
